concepts.gloss_en: way, path (noun) — gematria 224 = 2×YBK / 2×baki; the 'way of teshuvah' and the 'way in the sea' opened in Elul
to tread / issue (verb) — read here as the aspect of union (zivug), derived from 'all flesh corrupted its way' (Gen 6:12)

reason_for_human: Three occurrences (778, 3058, 4120) are the noun derekh 'way/path' — all vocalized with final segol (or its pausal qamatz דָּרֶךְ), all tied to the same gematria 224 / 2×baki and the 'way in the sea'/'way of teshuvah' motif; these clearly merge. Occurrence 1047 is vocalized דָּרַךְ (final patach), a verb form glossed 'issued/tread' and identified with zivug (union), so its vocalization and part-of-speech differ from the noun. Following 'vocalization is authoritative' and 'under-merge beats over-merge,' I split the verb out rather than fold it into the noun.
